qualifier: The 18-case benchmark uses hand-written cases with constructed outputs, so it tests that the metric suite separates good answers from bad ones. It is not an evaluation of any language model, and token-overlap faithfulness is a heuristic.

maref.text: MAREF, the multi-metric reliability framework for LLM agents, is a proposal. It has no public repository, no experiment and no result. The playground below scores recorded sample runs with deterministic proxies from llmeval to show the idea; it does not measure any model.

bridge: The most worked-through evaluation in my portfolio is in the Copilot: a frozen, hash-locked held-out retrieval set, mutation checks on every defence, an adversarial draft corpus whose failures are kept, and a real-model protocol that is frozen but not yet run.
